verdict: Simulated outcome under stated assumptions: Corner Brew takes a median share of 0.12 (p10 0.11, p90 0.15). Biggest threat: Chain café responds with a 20% price cut (share 0.122 -> 0.101 (-0.020, -16.8%)). Fragility 0.09, confidence low.
who_buys: Remote workers: 28 of 60 simulated agents chose Corner Brew (0.47)
who_rejects: Office lunch crowd: 8 of 90 simulated agents chose Corner Brew (0.09); most chose Hawker kopi stall
Students on a budget: 5 of 90 simulated agents chose Corner Brew (0.06); most chose Hawker kopi stall
Hawker loyalists: 0 of 60 simulated agents chose Corner Brew (0.00); most chose Hawker kopi stall

risks.title: Chain café responds with a 20% price cut
risks.evidence: Competitor Strategist: the rival's best one-step response among the bounded moves.

risks.title: Customers are more price-sensitive than assumed
risks.evidence: Devil's Advocate: if price sensitivity is 20% higher than assumed, the simulated share changes as shown.

risks.title: Willingness to pay is lower than assumed
risks.evidence: Devil's Advocate: if willingness to pay (budget) is 20% lower than assumed, the simulated share changes as shown.

experiments.title: Loyalty-card retention check against Chain café
experiments.hypothesis: A stamp card keeps repeat visits steady even if Chain café reacts with a price cut, a new menu item or a promotion.
experiments.pass_threshold: Proposed test threshold (not an established benchmark): at least 30% of first-time stamp-card holders return within 14 days.

experiments.title: Tasting event with a price-ladder card
experiments.hypothesis: After tasting, students and office workers state they would pay S$4.80 rather than switch back to a cheaper option.
experiments.pass_threshold: Proposed test threshold (not an established benchmark): at least 40% of 30+ tasters pick S$4.80 or higher on the price-ladder card.

experiments.title: Price-board test at S$4.80 vs S$3.84
experiments.hypothesis: Enough walk-past customers buy Corner Brew at S$4.80 that the lower S$3.84 price is not needed.
experiments.pass_threshold: Proposed test threshold (not an established benchmark): over two comparable weekday lunch hours, purchases at S$4.80 reach at least 70% of purchases at S$3.84.

limitations: Confidence capped at low: results come from the mock engine adapter, not the real engine.
Simulated outcome under stated assumptions; not a forecast of real sales.
